candidates.snippet: 797: Education and early career - Began studies and early work in mathematics and astronomy, likely in Baghdad. 820: Publication of 'The Compendious Book on Calculation by Completion and Balancing' - Published his seminal work on algebra, introducing systematic solutions to linear and quadratic equations. 830: Work on astronomy and geography - Contributed to astronomical tables and geographical works, including a world map. 846: Death - Passed away, leaving a profound legacy in mathematics and science.
